description: See what an AI changed in a backend without reading code: use-case flow animation with a change overlay derived from git diff. Zero dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: See what an AI changed in a backend, without reading code
interface.longDescription: Builds a single-page use-case flow animation of a backend repository and highlights what changed, derived from git diff. Every claim is backed by file:line evidence checked against the real source. Zero dependencies.
